title: Redlands mass sighting of silver disc
summary: Merrick tells of Redlands mass sighting of silver disc, about 1968 at Redlands, California, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 200 people see silver disc 40 to 50 ft in diameter, 200 feet altitude. Um 1968, Redlands, California. Um James McDonald did it.

plain: A man named Merrick, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says that in 1968 in Redlands, California, about 200 people saw a silver disc 40 to 50 feet across, hovering about 200 feet up. He says the case was investigated by a researcher named James McDonald. If true, so many witnesses at once would make it hard to dismiss as one person's mistake.
